crossRefs.note: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions, as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much…
“Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on…
He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

parallels.note: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.

translations.web: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.
translations.bsb: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.
translations.kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
translations.asv: And he left them again, and went away, and prayed a third time, saying again the same words.
